nodes.description: Public constant string holding the contract name 'TokensFarmCongress'.
Interface reference to the members registry contract used for membership and quorum checks.
Public counter of total proposals created, used as the next proposal id.
Public mapping from proposal id to the Proposal struct (targets, values, signatures, calldatas, votes, flags, timestamp, receipts).
External one-time setter that assigns the members registry address, guarded by a zero-address check.
External onlyMember function creating a proposal from target/value/signature/calldata arrays; increments proposalCount and stores the proposal.
External onlyMember function that delegates msg.sender, proposalId and support to _castVote.
Internal vote recorder that writes receipts and tallies forVotes/againstVotes using add256.
External onlyMember payable function that marks a proposal executed, checks quorum, and performs arbitrary low-level calls to proposal targets with values.
External onlyMember function that cancels a proposal after a 259200 second time lock and only if quorum was not reached.
External view function returning the target/value/signature/calldata arrays of a proposal.
External view function returning the members registry address.
Internal pure checked addition helper that reverts on overflow.
Payable receive fallback that emits ReceivedEther with msg.sender and msg.value.
Modifier that requires membersRegistry.isMember(msg.sender) to be true.
External view interface call into the members registry to verify an address is a member.
External view interface call into the members registry returning the minimal quorum.
Caller-controlled address used for membership checks, proposal proposer, voter identity and ether receipt events.
Miner-influenceable timestamp recorded on proposal creation and used for the cancel time lock.
Low-level .call{value:...}(callData) to an arbitrary proposal target inside a loop, executed after the executed flag is set but before the loop completes.
Unchecked Solidity 0.6 'a + b' addition guarded afterwards by a require(c >= a) overflow check.
Comparison block.timestamp >= proposal.timestamp + 259200 used as the cancellation time lock.
Unchecked 'proposalCount++' increment used to derive the new proposal id.
Address parameter cast to ICongressMembersRegistry and stored.
Array of target addresses for the proposal actions.
Array of ether values passed to each proposal action.
Array of function signature strings for the proposal actions.
Array of calldata blobs for the proposal actions.
Human readable description emitted with ProposalCreated.
Id of the proposal being voted on.
Boolean indicating for or against the proposal.
Address whose vote receipt is recorded.
Proposal id used to index the proposals mapping.
Boolean selecting forVotes or againstVotes tally.
Id of the proposal to execute.
Id of the proposal to cancel.
Id of the proposal whose actions are returned.
First addend of the checked addition.
Second addend of the checked addition.
In-memory Proposal struct built in propose and written into the proposals mapping.
Assembled calldata (raw or selector+args) forwarded to the external low-level call.
Return flag of the low-level call checked by require.
Loop index over proposal.targets in execute.
Storage pointer into proposals[proposalId] used by _castVote.
Storage pointer to proposal.receipts[voter] tracking hasVoted/support.
Storage pointer into proposals[proposalId] used by getActions.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to membersRegistry.isMember inside the onlyMember modifier to gate privileged calls.
onlyMember invokes the isMember registry check on the caller.
The membersRegistry state variable provides the isMember call target.
The membersRegistry state variable provides the getMinimalQuorum call target.
propose is guarded by the onlyMember modifier.
castVote is guarded by the onlyMember modifier.
execute is guarded by the onlyMember modifier.
cancel is guarded by the onlyMember modifier.
msg.sender is stored as the proposal proposer and emitted in ProposalCreated.
msg.sender is forwarded to _castVote as the voter identity.
msg.sender is emitted in the ReceivedEther event.
block.timestamp is stored as the proposal creation timestamp.
block.timestamp gates whether a proposal may be cancelled.
_membersRegistry is cast and assigned to the membersRegistry state variable.
setMembersRegistry writes the membersRegistry state variable.
targets parameter is stored into the new proposal.
values parameter is stored into the new proposal.
signatures parameter is stored into the new proposal.
calldatas parameter is stored into the new proposal.
description parameter is emitted in ProposalCreated.
proposalId parameter is forwarded to _castVote.
support parameter is forwarded to _castVote.
voter parameter indexes the receipt mapping.
proposalId parameter indexes the proposals mapping.
support parameter selects the vote tally branch.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to execute.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to cancel.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal whose actions are read.
a is the first operand of the checked addition.
b is the second operand of the checked addition.
newProposal is written into proposals[newProposal.id].
callData is forwarded as the payload of the arbitrary low-level call.
Loop index i selects the target, value, signature and calldata for each external call.
execute performs proposal.targets[i].call{value: proposal.values[i]}(callData) on attacker-influenced targets.
The low-level call can re-enter execute while it is still iterating (the executed flag is set before all calls and quorum state is not re-checked per call).
The low-level call can re-enter castVote/_castVote, allowing intermediate vote accounting.
castVote delegates directly to _castVote.
_castVote uses add256 when incrementing forVotes/againstVotes.
propose executes the unchecked proposalCount++ increment.
add256 performs the unchecked a + b addition afterwards validated by require(c >= a).
cancel evaluates the time lock comparison on block.timestamp and the stored proposal timestamp.
block.timestamp is a direct operand of the time lock comparison.
execute reads the minimal quorum from the members registry.
cancel reads the minimal quorum to decide cancelability.
_castVote writes vote tallies and receipts into the proposals mapping.
execute reads proposal fields and sets the executed flag on the proposals mapping.
cancel sets the canceled flag on the proposal.
propose stores the newly created proposal in the proposals mapping.
propose increments and reads proposalCount for the new id.
getActions reads the stored proposal arrays.
_castVote's proposal storage pointer aliases the proposals mapping entry.
receipt is fetched from proposal.receipts[voter].
getActions' p storage pointer aliases the proposals mapping entry.
The success flag of the low-level call is validated by require inside execute.
execute builds callData (raw calldata or selector + calldata) inside the loop.
getMembersRegistry returns the membersRegistry state variable address.
